analysis.title: Dark Chocolate Editorial Showcase
analysis.notes: A near-black canvas organizes warm, tactile macro imagery around an oversized ivory serif headline. The composition balances refined editorial typography with soft glassy controls, organic curves, and generous negative space.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a cinematic macro still life of a sculptural dark chocolate form on a nearly black background, with subtle flowing grooves and organic contours catching faint warm highlights. Use deep cocoa brown, burnt amber, and soft ivory reflections, with dramatic low-key lighting, shallow depth of field, tactile surface detail, and large areas of negative space. Compose it as a refined editorial website hero image: asymmetrical framing, mysterious atmosphere, restrained luxury, no text, no logos, no packaging, no recognizable brand elements.
